sourceTitle: Ask Maps is coming to Europe.
originalTitle: Ask Maps is coming to Europe.

blocks.text: Ask Maps is the biggest update to Google Maps in over a decade. Powered by the world’s freshest map and Gemini models, it answers complex, real-world questions a map couldn't before. Now, Ask Maps is expanding to 30+ countries across Europe.
blocks.zh: Ask Maps 是 Google 地图十多年来最大的一次更新。它由全球最新的地图和 Gemini 模型驱动，能够回答地图以前无法回答的复杂现实问题。现在，Ask Maps 正在扩展到欧洲 30+ 个国家。
blocks.en: Ask Maps is the biggest update to Google Maps in over a decade. Powered by the world’s freshest map and Gemini models, it answers complex, real-world questions a map couldn't before. Now, Ask Maps is expanding to 30+ countries across Europe.

blocks.text: With information about over 300 million places, including reviews from more than 500 million contributors, Ask Maps is personalised to you and makes it easy to turn plans into action. Try:
blocks.zh: Ask Maps 拥有超过 3 亿个地点的信息，包括超过 5 亿贡献者的评价，它为你提供个性化体验，让你轻松将计划付诸行动。试试：
blocks.en: With information about over 300 million places, including reviews from more than 500 million contributors, Ask Maps is personalised to you and makes it easy to turn plans into action. Try:

blocks.text: Asking anything about anywhere: Ask “where can I charge my phone ASAP” or “find me a public tennis court with lights for playing tonight”.
blocks.zh: 询问任何地点的任何问题：问“我在哪里可以尽快给手机充电”或“帮我找一个今晚可以打球的有灯光的公共网球场”。
blocks.en: Asking anything about anywhere: Ask “where can I charge my phone ASAP” or “find me a public tennis court with lights for playing tonight”.

blocks.text: Letting Ask Maps be your on-the-go companion: Create a trip itinerary, complete with “Know Before You Go” insider tips and real-time info about the weather and parking for each stop.
blocks.zh: 让 Ask Maps 成为你旅途中的伴侣：创建旅行行程，附上“出发前须知”的内部贴士，以及每个停留地点的天气和停车实时信息。
blocks.en: Letting Ask Maps be your on-the-go companion: Create a trip itinerary, complete with “Know Before You Go” insider tips and real-time info about the weather and parking for each stop.

blocks.text: Searching your lists in seconds: Skip scrolling through hundreds of saved places. Just ask “Which spots saved in my lists have availability for 5 in 30 minutes?”
blocks.zh: 在几秒钟内搜索你的列表：无需在数百个已保存的地点中滚动浏览。只需问“我列表中保存的地点有哪些能在 30 分钟内为 5 人提供可用名额？”
blocks.en: Searching your lists in seconds: Skip scrolling through hundreds of saved places. Just ask “Which spots saved in my lists have availability for 5 in 30 minutes?”

blocks.text: Learn about what else you can do with Ask Maps here and here.
blocks.zh: 在此处和此处了解你还可以用 Ask Maps 做些什么。
blocks.en: Learn about what else you can do with Ask Maps here and here.
